channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Western allies warn North Korean IT workers funding nuclear arsenal
item.description: Pyongyang accused of using hard currency earned by AI-assisted workers to power armaments programme.

item.title: The promise I made to Ismail al-Ghoul
item.description: He asked me to keep telling Gaza’s story. Two years after Israel killed him, I have not stopped.

item.title: Russia and Ukraine report casualties as they continue to trade attacks
item.description: Ukraine hit Russian oil refineries several times, while Russia struck Dnipropetrovsk and a cargo vessel near Odesa.

item.title: Spain deploys military to Ceuta after migrant surge: What we know
item.description: At least 34 people reported killed trying to cross into the Spanish enclave bordering Morocco.

item.title: Bowen: Plan for Hamas to disarm faces big obstacles, yet it offers rare hope for Gaza
item.description: The realities of politics, war, zero trust, the deaths of thousands and the destruction of Gaza will make any agreement very complicated.

item.title: At least five members of same family killed in Russian missile attack, Zelensky says
item.description: A six-year-old girl and two boys, aged 11 and 17, were among six killed in a village near the central city of Kryvyi Rih.

item.title: Why limited war with the US may suit Iran better than peace
item.description: Iran may believe it can control its conflict carefully enough to keep pressure on the US while avoiding an all-out war.

item.title: Danube's record low levels force shutdown of Hungary's only nuclear plant
item.description: Romania, Bulgaria and Serbia are also grappling with the effects of a series of prolonged heatwaves and low rainfall.

item.title: Cyanide in tomato pesticide killed 15 elephants, Kenyan officials suspect
item.description: Foul play is ruled out in the record number of elephant deaths for decades in this area of southern Kenya.

item.title: Salman Rushdie attacker convicted of terror offences
item.description: Hadi Matar, 28, was convicted of attempting to help Hezbollah by attacking the British-Indian author.
